# The document is one of the project's own files, read through the project:
# a path outside it is refused before anything is read, and a symlink inside
# it that points out is refused where it is opened. The import is the
# repository's to write, and the plugin is the library's, which reads
# without asking: the project is what holds the read.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off
symlink proj/link.yml -> ../outside/secret.yml

! sngl check proj/abs.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:/etc/hostname": scheme "openapi": openapi:/etc/hostname is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/up.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:../outside/secret.yml": scheme "openapi": openapi:../outside/secret.yml is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/link.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./link.yml": .*gen.lines: openat link.yml: path escapes from parent'

-- proj/abs.sngl --
import api "openapi:/etc/hostname"

const x = 1
-- proj/up.sngl --
import api "openapi:../outside/secret.yml"

const x = 1
-- proj/link.sngl --
import api "openapi:./link.yml"

const x = 1
-- outside/secret.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: Secret, version: "1"}
paths: {}
